2027-08-01.title: Preparing for God’s Presence
2027-08-01.verse: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us to eat.
2027-08-01.observation: Most people I know do not invite people over to their home without cleaning up first. We all should prepare ourselves before going to special events like weddings or funerals. Where I come from in the Deep South, it was considered rude to show up at a party without at least offering to bring something. However, how many of us walk into our time with God without preparing our hearts first? We prepare more for a meeting with our boss than for a “meeting” with the King of the Universe. This does not mean we should only act formal around the things of God and lose the relational component. I think we should challenge ourselves to remember that our Heavenly Father loves us fully AND He is the King of all. There should be a healthy respect.
2027-08-01.application: Before jumping into your devotional time tomorrow, take a few moments to prepare your heart to commune with God.
2027-08-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always welcoming us into Your presence.

2027-08-02.title: Trusting God in Hard Times
2027-08-02.verse: Then Jesus, calling out with a loud voice, said, “Father, ” And after he said this he breathed his last.
2027-08-02.observation: Have you ever had something bad happen that you simply did not understand? Perhaps you were fired from a job you loved. Perhaps you just knew you were going to marry the love of your life only to have them fall in love with another person. Maybe you were looking forward to retirement life only to find out you have cancer. What do you do when you find yourself in a terrible situation and it looks like you are not coming out of it the way you hoped? Jesus was the only innocent person to ever live. Jesus was the only One who did not deserve the Cross He bore for all of us. There was no rescue coming. He was going to be brutally killed for sins He had not committed. At the end of it, He showed us how to finish well. He told His Father He still trusted Him, even though the worst was happening. Can you trust God that much?
2027-08-02.application: No matter what hard thing is happening in your life, refuse to lose your trust in the Lord.
2027-08-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being completely trustworthy.

2027-08-03.title: The Word Changes Our Hearts
2027-08-03.verse: They said to each other, “Didn’t our hearts burn within us while he was speaking with us on the road, while he was explaining the scriptures to us?
2027-08-03.observation: They said that as Jesus shared the Word and explained the Gospel, their hearts burned within them. This is why it is so important to not only read the Bible, but to work to understand it. Anyone can read the Bible. It takes effort to understand the claims it is making. When we begin to put the pieces together and understand the heart of God, it changes us forever. We begin to realize this plan is not just for the world. It is for us. He came to save you and me.
2027-08-03.application: Take a moment to realize that the Bible is true. It is pointing each one of us to salvation.
2027-08-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for saving us.
